stories.headline: Anti-smart-glasses detector apps go mainstream
stories.subtitle: Popular Science spotlights apps like Nearby Glasses and ZuckOff that scan Bluetooth to warn when camera glasses are nearby.

stories.headline: ESPN immersive college football kicks off on Quest today
stories.subtitle: Live 180° 8K games with Dolby Atmos in the TV app, starting with Texas vs Oklahoma; weekly games through the playoffs.

stories.headline: Meta donates 1,000 Ray-Ban Meta glasses to Singapore's disability community
stories.subtitle: Joel Kaplan announced 1,000 glasses for Singapore's blind and low-vision community, plus $30K for accessibility training.

stories.headline: Meta's Muse AI agent comes to iPad
stories.subtitle: Muse is now a dedicated iPad app — another step toward the agent living on phone, tablet, and glasses.

stories.headline: Dutch eyewear giant Hans Anders pulls Ray-Ban Meta from 400 stores over privacy fears
stories.subtitle: The Dutch chain halted sales at ~400 stores over secret-filming fears. Meta's answer: the LED that can't be switched off.
